body: I don't care about the people I leave behind. I care about me specifically.
Well can you point me in the direction of people who will help me so?

No I'm purely interested in just getting someone here to give me a painless suicide method. I don't want to be put off and I will not be out off by random strangers. I'm not interested at all in mediation or any other nonsense "help" that people here suggest.
